description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

New Jersey Resources is seeking an Associate Business Application Developer to support the operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and enhancement of business applications. The role partners with business users and technical teams to ensure application reliability, resolve issues, implement enhancements, and help develop, test, and deploy new capabilities.
Business application developer building, integrating, testing, deploying, and supporting REST-enabled enterprise software

Responsibilities:
• Develop and maintain business applications using object-oriented design principles and established coding standards
• Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, and production support
• Build, consume, test, and support REST APIs, web services, and system integrations
• Support application deployments across development, test, and production environments
• Write clean, maintainable, secure, and well-documented code
• Apply unit testing, debugging, logging, code-review, and source-control practices to improve software quality
• Create and maintain technical documentation, including design notes, API documentation, deployment instructions, and support procedures
• Use AI-assisted tools such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, or similar tools for coding, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and research while following company guidelines
• Communicate progress, risks, and support needs clearly and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives
• Monitor application performance, respond to incidents, and assist with issue resolution to maintain system availability and user satisfaction
• Monitor application performance, respond to incidents, and assist with issue resolution to maintain system availability and user satisfaction

Requirements:
• Bachelors degree in Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field
• Up to 3 years of relevant experience with software development, application support, or a related technical area. Experience may include internships, co-ops, academic projects, or professional work

Skills:
• Bachelors degree in Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field
• Up to 3 years of relevant experience with software development, application support, or a related technical area. Experience may include internships, co-ops, academic projects, or professional work

Pay: $64K/yr - $86K/yr
